help: litemiyu --bare     first session without features: no tools, no context

litemiyu --rescue   rescue mode: nothing is saved to disk (no session log,
                      config or input history), only the file, command,
                      scheduling and question tools; the session is not kept
                      after closing
litemiyu --version  print the version and exit (also -V)

Rescue provider (command-line options override the environment, and both
override the config; with none given, models.chat from the config is used):

LITEMIYU_RESCUE_BASE_URL  --base-url <url>   provider address; the driver adds
                            the path (e.g. https://api.deepseek.com/v1)

LITEMIYU_RESCUE_API_KEY   (environment only) key; without it requests carry
                                               no authentication
